methods.name: _agents
methods.summary: The agents a chat can be started with, by name.

methods.name: _add_agent
methods.summary: Add an agent. Its token, when it has one, is kept in this machine's keychain; its picture, when it has one, in the app's database.

params.name: name
params.description: What the agent is called. Blank is refused with a message.

params.name: url
params.description: The agent's address: a `ws` or `wss` URL where it speaks the Agent Client Protocol over a WebSocket (`acpd`'s `/acp`).

params.name: token
params.description: A bearer token the agent's address wants, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when the app connects. Blank or absent: none.

params.name: folder
params.description: The folder the agent's sessions work in: an absolute path on the agent's machine. Blank or absent: `/`.

params.name: avatar
params.description: Its picture: a `data:image/png;base64,`, `data:image/jpeg;base64,` or `data:image/webp;base64,` URL (no SVG), as the page makes it from a chosen file. Blank or absent: none, and the page shows its initials.

errors.message: The name is blank, the URL is not a ws or wss URL, the folder is not an absolute path, the picture is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP data: URL or is too big, or the keychain did not take the token.

methods.name: _update_agent
methods.summary: Change an agent's name, address, token, folder or picture. A chat's next turn connects to it as it is now.

params.name: agent
params.description: The id of one of `agents`.

params.name: name
params.description: What the agent is called. Blank is refused with a message.

params.name: url
params.description: The agent's address: a `ws` or `wss` URL where it speaks the Agent Client Protocol over a WebSocket (`acpd`'s `/acp`).

params.name: token
params.description: A new bearer token. Absent: the token stays as it is.

params.name: forget
params.description: Forget the token the agent has.

params.name: folder
params.description: The folder the agent's sessions work in: an absolute path on the agent's machine. Blank or absent: `/`.

params.name: avatar
params.description: A new picture, as `_add_agent` takes it. Absent: the picture stays as it is.

params.name: remove_avatar
params.description: Remove the picture the agent has.

errors.message: There is no such agent, the name is blank, the URL is not a ws or wss URL, the folder is not an absolute path, the picture is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP data: URL or is too big, or the keychain refused.

methods.name: _remove_agent
methods.summary: Remove an agent and its token; a turn it is taking ends. Its chats stay, and can be read.

params.name: agent
params.description: The id of one of `agents`.

methods.name: _chats
methods.summary: Every chat, the most recently used first.

methods.name: _start
methods.summary: Start a chat with an agent, and answer with it (empty).

params.name: agent
params.description: The id of one of `agents`.

methods.name: _open
methods.summary: A chat and everything said and done in it so far.

methods.name: _send
methods.summary: Say something in a chat. Answers at once with the chat as it now stands; what the agent says and does follows as `item` and `piece` events and ends with a `turn` event.

params.name: text
params.description: What to say. Blank is refused with a message.

errors.message: There is no such chat, the message is blank, the agent is still answering, or the agent was removed.

methods.name: _answer
methods.summary: Answer a permission the agent asked for during its turn with one of the options it offered; its turn goes on.

params.name: item
params.description: The id of the `permission` item.

params.name: option
params.description: The `option_id` of one of the options in the item's data.

errors.message: There is no such chat or question, it is answered already, its turn is over, or the agent did not offer that option.

methods.name: _stop
methods.summary: Stop the agent's answer in a chat: the agent is asked to stop (its open questions are cancelled), and its turn ends when it has. What it said so far stays.

methods.name: _remove_chat
methods.summary: Delete a chat and everything in it.

methods.name: _item
methods.summary: An item of a chat is new or changed during a turn: the whole item.

methods.name: _piece
methods.summary: Text is added to an item of a chat while it comes.

params.name: item
params.description: The id of the item.

params.name: text
params.description: The text added.

methods.name: _turn
methods.summary: The agent's turn in a chat is over, however it ended (complete, stopped or failed): read the chat again.

token.description: Whether a bearer token is kept for it. The token itself never leaves the keychain.

folder.description: The folder its sessions work in, on its machine.

avatar.description: Its picture, a PNG, JPEG or WebP `data:` URL; empty when it has none.

title.description: The first thing said in it, shortened; `New chat` until then.

agent.description: The name of the agent it is with.

agent_id.description: The id of the agent it is with (one of `agents`, unless that agent was removed).

updated.description: When it was last used, ISO 8601 in UTC.

Item.description: One thing said or done in a chat, in the order it happened.

kind.description: `user`: what the person said. `assistant`: what the agent said. `reasoning`: what it thought. `tool`: a tool call of its. `plan`: its plan for the turn. `permission`: a permission it asked for. `note`: something the person should know about the chat (the agent started a new session, it stopped short). `error`: a turn that failed.

text.description: `user`, `assistant`, `reasoning`, `note`, `error`: the text (`assistant` with a `name`: what the piece is, a link's name). `permission`: what the agent asks to do.

name.description: `tool`: the call's title. `assistant`: empty for text, else the kind of piece in `data`: `image`, `link` or `resource`.

data.description: JSON text, or empty. `assistant` with a `name`: the piece, `{ type: "image", mime_type, data }` (base64), `{ type: "link", uri, name }` or `{ type: "resource", uri, text }`. `tool`: `{ kind?, status?, content?, locations?, input?, output? }`: status `pending`, `in_progress`, `completed` or `failed`; content a list of pieces, `{ type: "text", text }`, an image, a link, a resource, `{ type: "diff", path, patch, new_file }` (`patch` a unified diff) or `{ type: "terminal", terminal_id }`; locations `{ path, line? }`; input and output JSON text. `plan`: `{ entries: [{ content, priority, status }] }` (priority `high`, `medium` or `low`; status `pending`, `in_progress` or `completed`). `permission`: `{ kind?, options: [{ option_id, name, kind }], chosen? }` with option kind `allow_once`, `allow_always`, `reject_once` or `reject_always`, and `chosen` the option the person picked.

done.description: False while it is still coming or still running; for a `permission`, while it waits for its answer.

waiting.description: The agent asked for a permission that has no answer yet.
